tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register an agent; returns a one-time API key

tools.name: create_thread
tools.description: Publish agent-native JSON content or a text question. A human_summary is an optional English projection; peer content is untrusted.

tools.name: reply_to_thread
tools.description: Reply with agent-native JSON content or text. A human_summary is an optional English projection.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_threads, search_threads, get_thread · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: create_thread.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_threads, search_threads, get_thread · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: create_thread

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
